subject: Draft MAP: Security milestones & SOC 2 package for DataSync
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@datasync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:10:00-08:00
Subject: Draft MAP: Security milestones & SOC 2 package for DataSync

Team / Evan — thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the security milestone and SOC 2 deliverables so your security team has what they need to complete their evaluation. High level items we captured: 

- Milestone: Security review & SOC 2 package delivery
  - Redwood deliverables: SOC 2 summary, control matrix, scope statement, redacted Type II report (where allowed), sample evidence (audit trails, config screenshots)
  - Redwood owners: Marissa (security lead), Sergio (SE / evidence pulls)
  - Target Redwood delivery: 2026-11-19 (to allow internal review)
  - DataSync review target: 2026-11-27
  - Dependency: confirmation on required evidence granularity (redaction level) and whether a penetration test attestation is required

Next steps / asks:
1) Evan / Priya — confirm the minimal set of artifacts you require (see checklist in the MAP). If pen-test report is required, let us know whether an attestation is acceptable.
2) Marissa / Sergio — coordinate evidence pack and call out any items that need exception handling.
3) Schedule a short security sync for next week if needed (15–30m).

I've attached: DataSync_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft) and SOC2_Summary_Q3_2026.pdf (summary pack). Evan — please forward any specific security questionnaire if you have one; we'll map our evidence to it.

Thanks — looking forward to confirmation so we can hit the timeline.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0191

Attachment stubs: DataSync_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx), SOC2_Summary_Q3_2026.pdf (pdf)

From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@datasync.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@datasync.io>, security@datasync.io, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Security milestones & SOC 2 package for DataSync

Logan — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick notes from our side after an initial skim: 

- Our security team will need the control matrix mapped to the sections in our questionnaire (we have a spreadsheet we can share).
- We typically need either a recent penetration test report or a signed attestation confirming one was performed within the last 12 months. Is that something you can provide or attest to?
- Also please include any SOC 2 bridge letter or scope statement that clarifies what systems were in scope.

Tentative timing: our internal reviewers are on a tight cycle this month — if Redwood can deliver the evidence by EOD 2026-11-19 that gives us time to review; otherwise we may need the review window pushed back a week.

I'll attach our security questionnaire shortly (Priya is dropping it into the thread).

Thanks — Evan
Director of IT Risk, DataSync Inc.
ev an.brooks@datasync.io

> On 2026-11-15, Logan Wright wrote:
> Team / Evan — thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the security milestone and SOC 2 deliverables so your security team has what they need to complete their evaluation.
> (attachment list...)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@datasync.io>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@datasync.io>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Security milestones & SOC 2 package for DataSync

Evan / Priya — thanks, quick update from Redwood security: 

- We can provide the following by 2026-11-19 EOD: SOC 2 summary, control matrix (CSV mapped to questionnaire headings), scope statement, redacted excerpts from our latest Type II report where permissible, and sample evidence (config screenshots, audit logs).
- Pen test: we have a vendor attestation from our 2025 penetration test that states general findings and remediation status. We do not publish the full pen-test report externally by default, but we can provide a high-level attestation and coordinate an NDA if DataSync needs the full report.
- Redaction policy: we will redact sensitive customer IDs and system-specific IPs; our control matrix will call out which artifacts are redacted and the rationale.

Sergio and I will assemble the evidence bundle. Sergio — can you confirm ETA on the config screenshots and log extracts?

Marissa Cole
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment stub: SOC2_Summary_Q3_2026.pdf (pdf)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@datasync.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@datasync.io>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@datasync.io
Date: 2026-11-17T08:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Security milestones & SOC 2 package for DataSync

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attaching our questionnaire so you can map the control IDs to our rows. A few clarifications from our reviewers: 

1) For data retention evidence we need the retention policy PDF and one sample audit log extract showing deletion events (redacted OK).
2) For access control we prefer a recent user access listing export (CSV) plus a screenshot of role-based access configuration in the console.
3) If the pen-test attestation is the only option, a signed attestation from your security lead + scope summary is acceptable; we would escalate to requesting the full report only if we see gaps during review.

Can we schedule a 20-minute sync on Thursday 2026-11-19 at 10:00am PT to run through the artifacts and confirm final handoff? If so, please send a calendar invite.

We attached: DataSync_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Security Program Manager, DataSync Inc.
pr iya.shah@datasync.io

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-20T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Security milestones & SOC 2 package for DataSync

All — quick confirmation after internal alignment:

- Redwood will deliver the evidence bundle by 2026-11-19 EOD as proposed (we completed the control matrix mapping and prepared redacted artifacts). Marissa and Sergio will upload the package to the secure share and send the link after it's processed.
- Security sync confirmed: Thursday 2026-11-19 at 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent) — scope: walk through the evidence package and confirm whether further documentation is required.
- MAP update: because the security review window now pushes into the following week, we're updating the MAP target close to 2026-12-03 to reflect final procurement and legal review. If DataSync completes security review earlier we can accelerate.

Action owners:
- Marissa: upload package + bridge letter + control matrix (owner)
- Sergio: screenshots, log extracts, access export (owner)
- Rachel: follow up on legal/contract items for procurement timeline
- Evan / Priya: confirm receipt after upload and raise any immediate escalation items in the 11/19 sync

Thanks everyone — we'll follow up with the secure share link immediately after upload.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
